declare @$iiquery nvarchar(4000), @$i int, @$n int, @$stt_rec varchar(13), @$ngay smalldatetime, @$hddv_status char(1)
if not isnull(@$stt_rec_hddv, '') = '' begin
  select * into #stt from dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@$stt_rec_hddv, ',')
  select * into #ngay from dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@$ngay_hddv, ',')

    end

    set @$i = @$i + 1
  end
end

<![CDATA[
var currentIndex = -1;
var _controller = '';
function add$Post$TagCustomize(f, controller) {
    _controller = controller;
    var setIntervalPost = setInterval(function () {
        var textArea = document.getElementById(controller + '_PostMessageInput');
        if (textArea) {
            clearInterval(setIntervalPost);

            appendChildMentions(controller);
            addEventListenerTextArea(controller);
        }
    }, 100);
}
function appendChildMentions(controller) {
    var textAreaID = controller + '_PostMessageInput'
    var textArea = document.getElementById(textAreaID);

    var ul = document.createElement('ul')
    ul.setAttribute("id", "mentionsList");
    ul.setAttribute("style", "display: none;");
    ul.setAttribute("class", "MentionsList");

    textArea.parentElement.appendChild(ul);
    textArea.parentElement.style.position = "relative";
}

function addEventListenerTextArea(controller) {
    var textAreaID = controller + '_PostMessageInput'
    var textArea = document.getElementById(textAreaID)
    var mentionList = document.getElementById("mentionsList");

    var raw = localStorage.getItem("listUser").replace(/'/g, '"');
    var users = JSON.parse(raw);

    textArea.addEventListener("input", function () {
        var text = textArea.value;
        var cursorPos = textArea.selectionStart;

        // Lấy phần trước con trỏ
        var beforeCursor = text.substring(0, cursorPos);
        //var match = beforeCursor.match(/@(\w{3,})$/); // @ + từ >=3 ký tự
        var match = beforeCursor.match(/@([\p{L}\p{N}_\s]{3,})$/u); // regex Unicode

        if (match) {
            var keyword = normalize(match[1]).toLowerCase();

            var results = [];
            for (var i = 0; i < users.length; i++) {
                if (normalize(users[i]).toLowerCase().includes(keyword)) {
                    results.push(users[i]);
                }
            }
            renderMentionList(results);
        } else {
            mentionList.style.display = "none";
        }
    });

    textArea.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
        if (mentionList.style.display === "none") return;

        var items = mentionList.querySelectorAll("li");

        if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
            e.preventDefault();
            currentIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % items.length;
            highlight(items);
        }
        else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
            e.preventDefault();
            currentIndex = (currentIndex - 1 + items.length) % items.length;
            highlight(items);
        }
        else if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === "Tab") {
            if (currentIndex >= 0 && items[currentIndex]) {
                e.preventDefault();
                insertMention(items[currentIndex].innerText);
            }
        }
    });
}

function renderMentionList(results) {
    var textAreaID = _controller + '_PostMessageInput'
    var textArea = document.getElementById(textAreaID)
    var mentionList = document.getElementById("mentionsList");

    mentionList.innerHTML = "";
    currentIndex = 0;

    if (results.length === 0) {
        mentionList.style.display = "none";
        currentIndex = -1;
        return;
    }

    for (var i = 0; i < results.length; i++) {
        var r = results[i];
        var li = document.createElement("li");
        li.textContent = r;
        li.addEventListener("click", function () { insertMention(r, textArea); });
        mentionList.appendChild(li);
    }
    
    mentionList.style.display = "block";
    highlight(mentionList.querySelectorAll("li"));
}

function highlight(items) {
    for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
        if (i === currentIndex) {
            items[i].classList.add("selected-mention");
            items[currentIndex].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
        } else {
            items[i].classList.remove("selected-mention");
        }
    }
}

function insertMention(username) {
    var textAreaID = _controller + '_PostMessageInput'
    var textArea = document.getElementById(textAreaID)
    var mentionList = document.getElementById("mentionsList");

    var cursorPos = textArea.selectionStart;
    var text = textArea.value;
    var beforeCursor = text.substring(0, cursorPos);
    var afterCursor = text.substring(cursorPos);
    //var newBefore = beforeCursor.replace(/@(\w{3,})$/, "@" + username + " ");
    var newBefore = beforeCursor.replace(/@([\p{L}\p{N}_\s]{3,})$/u, "@" + username + " "); // regex Unicode
    textArea.value = newBefore + afterCursor;
    mentionList.style.display = "none";
    textArea.focus();
}

function normalize(str) {
    return str.normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "").toLowerCase();
}

    when @$stock$View$Type = '2' then ' left join cdvitri3213 e on a.ma_vt = e.ma_vt and a.ma_kho = e.ma_kho and a.ma_vi_tri = e.ma_vi_tri'

    else '' end

  select top 0 ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo into #dton from #d

  else if @$stock$View$Type = '2' insert into #dton select distinct ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, '' from #d
  else if @$stock$View$Type = '3' insert into #dton select distinct ma_kho, '', ma_vt, ma_lo from #d
  else if @$stock$View$Type = '4' insert into #dton select distinct ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo from #d
